messages:
marco: FYI opened PR #4823 to update Optimize toolkit — samples + migration checklist. Quant profiles section still references old 8-bit profile. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823
elaine: saw it. I'll do a pass on links and the quickstart steps today. any specific failing links?
samir: the caching example uses `kv_prefetch=True` which is deprecated — should use `enable_prefetch` with `policy='kv'`. Also the snippet assumes `batch_size=16` for 1k tokens, that's going to OOM on smaller GPUs.
marco: good catch. samir can you paste a suggested snippet for the cache change?
samir: here —
```python
# recommended KV prefetch pattern
from redwood.optimize import PrefetchPolicy
client.update_cache_policy(policy=PrefetchPolicy.KV, prefetch=True)
```

samir: also add note about lowering batch_size for shortseq workloads: `batch_size=2-4` for <256 tokens.
tess: I can update python + go SDK snippets. prefer to keep examples showing both shortseq and longseq configs. i'll push commits to the PR branch.
elaine: I'll run linkcheck via the docs CI and fix any redirects. @docs-bot can you run the preview after my changes?
docs-bot: deploy-preview started for PR #4823 — build id 9823. status: queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:
marco: thanks. can we also add a short matrix for quant profiles (int8, int4) and when to prefer each? customers keep asking when to quantize vs prefer larger batch/caching investments.
samir: propose a 3-row table: perf tradeoffs, when to pick, known regressions. i'll draft.
tess: i'll include a brief example showing quant+kv cache working together (psa: kv cache shows uneven gains for int4 on small batch sizes).
elaine: if we get this in today we can include in next week's changelog. ping me when you push.
marco: perfect. tagging @devex for final SDK snippet review. :thumbsup:
devex: will review the snippets by EOD. small request: use URLs that are relative in docs to avoid future redirects.
marco: noted. thanks everyone — i'll wait for commits and then merge after CI green.
